ports.name: clk_i
ports.functionality: Supplies the rising edge used to sequence internal registers and port outputs. It times the bus_access, transmitter, receiver, IRQ, FIFO-overrun and control processes and thereby controls updates to ctrl, tx_engine, rx_engine and outputs.
ports.evidence: rising_edge(clk_i) appears in all named processes (bus_access, transmitter, receiver, irq generators, fifo_overrun, rtr_control)

ports.name: rstn_i
ports.functionality: Provides synchronous/asynchronous reset used by processes to initialise registers and outputs. It clears ctrl fields, engine state, FIFOs and IRQ outputs in each process's reset branch.
ports.evidence: if (rstn_i = '0') then branches in each process (bus_access, transmitter, receiver, irq generators, fifo_overrun, rtr_control)

ports.name: bus_req_i
ports.functionality: Carries bus transaction fields into the UART. The process bus_access reads its fields and uses them to update ctrl fields on writes and to form bus responses on reads, and other concurrent logic uses its fields for FIFO access.
ports.evidence: bus_access process uses bus_req_i.stb/rw/addr/data to drive ctrl fields and FIFO enables and to form bus_rsp_o

ports.name: bus_req_i.addr
ports.functionality: Provides the address bit(s) that select control vs data registers. The LSB bit addr(2) gates which ctrl fields are written or which response/data slice is returned on reads and also appears in simulation transmit condition.
ports.evidence: if (bus_req_i.addr(2) = '0') then branches in bus_access and tx/rx FIFO we/re assignments and sim_tx condition

ports.name: bus_req_i.data
ports.functionality: Supplies write data for control registers and TX FIFO. On writes it is sampled into ctrl fields and is mapped to tx_fifo.wdata for transmit requests; in simulation mode the lower byte is read for printing.
ports.evidence: bus_req_i.data(...) reads in bus_access and tx_fifo.wdata <= bus_req_i.data(7 downto 0)

ports.name: bus_req_i.ben
ports.functionality: Declared bus byte-enable field is not read or used by this source; no process or assignment references it.
ports.evidence: no occurrence except DECL in provided source

ports.name: bus_req_i.stb
ports.functionality: Indicates a valid bus transfer and both gates bus_access updates and directly sources bus response acknowledge and FIFO write/read enables. It is used as a condition and as the direct source of bus_rsp_o.ack.
ports.evidence: if (bus_req_i.stb = '1') then in bus_access; bus_rsp_o.ack <= bus_req_i.stb; tx_fifo.we and rx_fifo.re use bus_req_i.stb

ports.name: bus_req_i.rw
ports.functionality: Distinguishes read and write transfers inside bus_access and thereby gates whether ctrl fields are written or bus response/data are prepared; it appears in conditional branches controlling write vs read behaviour.
ports.evidence: if (bus_req_i.rw = '1') then / else in bus_access chooses write or read branches

ports.name: bus_req_i.src
ports.functionality: Declared bus source field is not read by this entity; no assignments or conditions reference it in this source.
ports.evidence: no occurrences beyond declaration

ports.name: bus_req_i.priv
ports.functionality: Declared but not referenced in the provided source, so it has no role inside this entity.
ports.evidence: no occurrences beyond declaration

ports.name: bus_req_i.debug
ports.functionality: Declared but not read or used by any logic in this source.
ports.evidence: no occurrences beyond declaration

ports.name: bus_req_i.amo
ports.functionality: Atomic memory operation flag is declared but not referenced by this UART implementation.
ports.evidence: no occurrences beyond declaration

ports.name: bus_req_i.amoop
ports.functionality: Declared AMO operation subfield is not used in the entity's logic.
ports.evidence: no occurrences beyond declaration

ports.name: bus_req_i.lock
ports.functionality: Declared lock field is not read or used by any logic in this source.
ports.evidence: no occurrences beyond declaration

ports.name: bus_req_i.fence
ports.functionality: Declared but not referenced; the UART logic does not use fence information.
ports.evidence: no occurrences beyond declaration

ports.name: bus_rsp_o
ports.functionality: Provides the bus response back to the requester. The clocked bus_access process drives its fields (ack, err, data) each cycle to report ack and to return control or data fields derived from ctrl and FIFOs.
ports.evidence: bus_access process (rising_edge(clk_i)) assigns bus_rsp_o.ack/err/data and slices from ctrl and FIFO signals

ports.name: bus_rsp_o.ack
ports.functionality: Holds the sampled bus strobe to acknowledge a transaction. It is set each clock to bus_req_i.stb inside the clocked bus_access process.
ports.evidence: bus_rsp_o.ack <= bus_req_i.stb inside bus_access rising_edge(clk_i)

ports.name: bus_rsp_o.err
ports.functionality: Reports an error status (always '0' here). It is cleared on every clock by the bus_access process.
ports.evidence: bus_rsp_o.err <= '0' in bus_access process (rising_edge(clk_i))

ports.name: bus_rsp_o.data
ports.functionality: Delivers returned register or FIFO data on reads. The bus_access clocked process clears it each cycle and then assigns slices derived from ctrl fields, FIFO indicators and engine status into specific bit positions.
role: aggregate of control and FIFO status
ports.evidence: bus_rsp_o.data <= (others => '0') and many slice assignments in bus_access process

ports.name: clkgen_en_o
ports.functionality: Forwards the ctrl.enable bit to the external clock generator. It is driven continuously from the internal ctrl.enable so external clock generation follows the control enable.
ports.evidence: concurrent assignment clkgen_en_o <= ctrl.enable

ports.name: clkgen_i
ports.functionality: Supplies prescaled clock bits; an indexed bit of this vector is sampled to produce uart_clk. The concurrent assignment reads clkgen_i at the index derived from ctrl.prsc.
ports.evidence: uart_clk <= clkgen_i(to_integer(unsigned(ctrl.prsc))) concurrent assignment

ports.name: uart_txd_o
ports.functionality: Reports the transmit-output value produced by the transmit engine. It is driven continuously from tx_engine.txd so the external TX pin follows the engine's output.
ports.evidence: concurrent assignment uart_txd_o <= tx_engine.txd

ports.name: uart_rxd_i
ports.functionality: Feeds serial RX samples into the receiver synchroniser. The receiver process samples uart_rxd_i into rx_engine.sync(2) and thereby supplies bits for the RX shift register and framing logic.
ports.evidence: rx_engine.sync(2) <= uart_rxd_i in receiver process (rising_edge(clk_i))

ports.name: uart_rtsn_o
ports.functionality: Provides the hardware flow-control RTS signal to the peer. The rtr_control process sets uart_rtsn_o each clock depending on ctrl.hwfc_en, ctrl.enable and rx_fifo.half, thereby asserting RTS when receiving should be paused.
ports.evidence: rtr_control process assigns uart_rtsn_o in rising_edge(clk_i) based on ctrl.hwfc_en, ctrl.enable, rx_fifo.half

ports.name: uart_ctsn_i
ports.functionality: Feeds remote CTS into the transmit engine. The transmitter process shifts uart_ctsn_i into tx_engine.cts so the engine observes the peer's CTS for hardware flow-control decisions.
ports.evidence: tx_engine.cts <= tx_engine.cts(0) & uart_ctsn_i in transmitter process (rising_edge(clk_i))

ports.name: irq_rx_o
ports.functionality: Signals RX-related interrupts based on enabled irq controls and FIFO status. The rx_irq_generator process computes irq_rx_o each clock from ctrl.enable and ctrl.irq_rx_* bits together with rx_fifo.avail/half/free.
ports.evidence: rx_irq_generator process sets irq_rx_o <= ctrl.enable and (...) in rising_edge(clk_i)

ports.name: irq_tx_o
ports.functionality: Signals TX-related interrupts according to enabled irq controls and TX FIFO status. The tx_irq_generator process updates irq_tx_o each clock from ctrl.enable, ctrl.irq_tx_* and tx_fifo.avail/half.
ports.evidence: tx_irq_generator process sets irq_tx_o <= ctrl.enable and (...) in rising_edge(clk_i)

signals.name: uart_clk
signals.functionality: Derived bit from clkgen_i chosen by ctrl.prsc to clock UART bit timing. It is assigned combinationally from clkgen_i indexed by ctrl.prsc and is sampled by transmitter and receiver processes to time baud operations.
signals.evidence: concurrent assignment uart_clk <= clkgen_i(to_integer(unsigned(ctrl.prsc)))

signals.name: ctrl
signals.functionality: Holds the UART configuration and IRQ enable/clear bits. Individual fields are captured from bus_req_i.data on writes in the bus_access clocked process and used across the entity to control engines, IRQs, and FIFO behaviour.
role: provides flags to engines and outputs
signals.evidence: bus_access process assigns ctrl.<fields> from bus_req_i.data on writes; ctrl fields used elsewhere

signals.name: ctrl.enable
signals.functionality: Captures the enable bit written from the bus and gates many behaviours (clock output, engine state bits, IRQ generation and FIFO clears). It is updated from bus_req_i.data and sampled throughout processes to enable or disable UART operation.
signals.evidence: ctrl.enable <= bus_req_i.data(ctrl_en_c) in bus_access; used to set tx_engine.state(2), rx_engine.state(1) and to compute clkgen_en_o and FIFO clears

signals.name: ctrl.sim_mode
signals.functionality: Holds the sim-mode enable written from the bus and gates simulation transmitter and FIFO clears. It is derived from bus_req_i.data and the SIM_MODE_EN generic and is used to force TX FIFO clear and to enable sim_tx path.
signals.evidence: ctrl.sim_mode <= bus_req_i.data(ctrl_sim_en_c) and bool_to_ulogic_f(sim_mode_en_c); tx_fifo.clear and rx_fifo.clear use ctrl.sim_mode

signals.name: ctrl.hwfc_en
signals.functionality: Captures the hardware-flow-control enable from bus writes and is used to decide RTS behaviour and to qualify CTS usage in the transmit state machine.
signals.evidence: ctrl.hwfc_en <= bus_req_i.data(ctrl_hwfc_en_c) in bus_access; rtr_control uses ctrl.hwfc_en; transmitter tests ctrl.hwfc_en in state transitions

signals.name: ctrl.prsc
signals.functionality: Holds a small index selecting which bit of clkgen_i drives uart_clk. It is written from bus data and used as the index in the concurrent assignment that derives uart_clk.
signals.evidence: ctrl.prsc <= bus_req_i.data(ctrl_prsc2_c downto ctrl_prsc0_c); uart_clk <= clkgen_i(to_integer(unsigned(ctrl.prsc)))

signals.name: ctrl.baud
signals.functionality: Stores the baud reload value written via the bus; transmitter and receiver load this value into their baud counters to generate bit timing.
signals.evidence: ctrl.baud <= bus_req_i.data(ctrl_baud9_c downto ctrl_baud0_c); used to set tx_engine.baudcnt and rx_engine.baudcnt in engines

signals.name: ctrl.irq_rx_nempty
signals.functionality: Captures the enable bit for RX non-empty interrupts from bus writes and is read by the rx_irq_generator to decide irq_rx_o assertion when rx_fifo.avail is true.
signals.evidence: ctrl.irq_rx_nempty <= bus_req_i.data(ctrl_irq_rx_nempty_c); rx_irq_generator uses ctrl.irq_rx_nempty

signals.name: ctrl.irq_rx_half
signals.functionality: Held enable bit for RX half-full interrupt; sampled from bus writes and used by rx_irq_generator together with rx_fifo.half.
signals.evidence: ctrl.irq_rx_half <= bus_req_i.data(ctrl_irq_rx_half_c); used in rx_irq_generator

signals.name: ctrl.irq_rx_full
signals.functionality: Held enable bit for RX full interrupt, captured from bus writes and used to compute irq_rx_o when rx_fifo.free is false.
signals.evidence: ctrl.irq_rx_full <= bus_req_i.data(ctrl_irq_rx_full_c); rx_irq_generator uses ctrl.irq_rx_full and rx_fifo.free

signals.name: ctrl.irq_tx_empty
signals.functionality: Captured TX-empty interrupt enable bit; used by tx_irq_generator to assert irq_tx_o when TX FIFO becomes empty (not tx_fifo.avail).
signals.evidence: ctrl.irq_tx_empty <= bus_req_i.data(ctrl_irq_tx_empty_c); tx_irq_generator uses ctrl.irq_tx_empty

signals.name: ctrl.irq_tx_nhalf
signals.functionality: Captured bit enabling TX near-half interrupt; tx_irq_generator uses it with tx_fifo.half to produce irq_tx_o.
signals.evidence: ctrl.irq_tx_nhalf <= bus_req_i.data(ctrl_irq_tx_nhalf_c); used in tx_irq_generator

signals.name: ctrl.clr_rx
signals.functionality: A writeable bit that is cleared each cycle and when asserted by a bus write causes rx_fifo.clear to be asserted (which forces the RX FIFO clear). It is captured from bus_req_i.data and cleared in bus_access between cycles.
signals.evidence: ctrl.clr_rx <= bus_req_i.data(ctrl_rx_clr_c) in bus_access; ctrl.clr_rx is reset to '0' in same process and rx_fifo.clear uses ctrl.clr_rx

signals.name: ctrl.clr_tx
signals.functionality: Writeable bit captured from bus writes that causes tx_fifo.clear to assert when set; it is cleared each cycle in bus_access to behave as a write-clear strobe.
signals.evidence: ctrl.clr_tx <= bus_req_i.data(ctrl_tx_clr_c) in bus_access; tx_fifo.clear <= ... or ctrl.clr_tx = '1'

signals.name: tx_engine
signals.functionality: Contains the state machine, shift register, counters and status for transmit operations. Its subfields are updated in the transmitter clocked process from tx_fifo and ctrl values and feed uart_txd_o and tx_fifo.re.
signals.evidence: transmitter process assigns many tx_engine.<fields> on rising_edge(clk_i)

signals.name: tx_engine.state
signals.functionality: Holds the 3-bit state of the transmitter FSM; bit2 is driven by ctrl.enable each cycle and the lower bits transition based on FIFO status, uart_clk and CTS/hwfc decisions. It controls when tx_fifo.re is asserted and when transmission shifts occur.
signals.evidence: transmitter process sets tx_engine.state(2) <= ctrl.enable and case tx_engine.state ... tx_fifo.re <= '1' when (tx_engine.state = "100")

signals.name: tx_engine.sreg
signals.functionality: Holds the byte plus stop bit for serial transmission; it is loaded from tx_fifo.rdata & '0' when starting and shifted right during bit timing, supplying tx_engine.txd from its LSB.
signals.evidence: tx_engine.sreg <= tx_fifo.rdata & '0' on start; shifted in transmitter when baudcnt expires; tx_engine.txd <= tx_engine.sreg(0)

signals.name: tx_engine.bitcnt
signals.functionality: Counts remaining bits to shift for a character transmission. It is initialised on start and decremented when baud periods complete, and when it reaches zero tx_engine.done is asserted.
signals.evidence: tx_engine.bitcnt <= "1011" at start, decremented in transmitter when baudcnt expires; tx_engine.done set when bitcnt = "0000"

signals.name: tx_engine.baudcnt
signals.functionality: Counts UART clock ticks down from ctrl.baud to time bit shifts. It is reloaded from ctrl.baud at the start of bits and decremented each uart_clk event to pace shifting.
signals.evidence: tx_engine.baudcnt <= ctrl.baud on state "100" and decremented when uart_clk = '1' in transmitter

signals.name: tx_engine.done
signals.functionality: Pulsed when a character transmission completes; it is cleared each cycle and set when tx_engine.bitcnt reaches zero, driving tx_fifo.re via tx_engine.state gating.
signals.evidence: tx_engine.done <= '1' when tx_engine.bitcnt = "0000"; tx_engine.done cleared at each rising_edge

signals.name: tx_engine.busy
signals.functionality: Combinationally reflects whether the transmit FSM is active (state != "00"). It is assigned with a simple concurrent conditional and read by bus_resp to report TX busy status.
signals.evidence: tx_engine.busy <= '0' when (tx_engine.state(1 downto 0) = "00") else '1'; bus_access uses tx_engine.busy in response

signals.name: tx_engine.cts
signals.functionality: Two-bit shift register that samples uart_ctsn_i to create a small history for the transmitter to observe remote CTS. It is shifted each clock and used with ctrl.hwfc_en to decide transmit progression.
signals.evidence: tx_engine.cts <= tx_engine.cts(0) & uart_ctsn_i in transmitter process

signals.name: tx_engine.txd
signals.functionality: Holds the current serial output bit driven to uart_txd_o. It is defaulted to '1' each cycle and set to tx_engine.sreg(0) during sending states, and is exported directly to uart_txd_o.
signals.evidence: tx_engine.txd <= '1' default then tx_engine.txd <= tx_engine.sreg(0) in state "111"; uart_txd_o <= tx_engine.txd

signals.name: rx_engine
signals.functionality: Contains the receiver FSM, shift register, counters, synchroniser and status. Its subfields are updated in the receiver clocked process from uart_rxd_i and ctrl.baud and when done supply rx_fifo.wdata and rx_fifo.we.
signals.evidence: receiver process assigns rx_engine.<fields> on rising_edge(clk_i); rx_fifo.wdata <= rx_engine.sreg(7 downto 0); rx_fifo.we <= rx_engine.done

signals.name: rx_engine.state
signals.functionality: Two-bit RX FSM state where one bit is synchronised to ctrl.enable; it advances on start detection and counts bits using baud timing to assemble bytes, ultimately asserting rx_engine.done.
signals.evidence: receiver sets rx_engine.state(1) <= ctrl.enable and uses rx_engine.sync for start detection; rx_engine.done set when rx_engine.bitcnt = "0000"

signals.name: rx_engine.sreg
signals.functionality: Shifts sampled serial bits into a register during RX bit timing. When reception completes rx_engine.sreg(7 downto 0) is forwarded to rx_fifo.wdata and rx_engine.done strobes write-enable to the FIFO.
signals.evidence: rx_engine.sreg <= rx_engine.sync(2) & rx_engine.sreg(... ) in receiver; rx_fifo.wdata <= rx_engine.sreg(7 downto 0)

signals.name: rx_engine.bitcnt
signals.functionality: Counts remaining bits to receive a character; initialised on start and decremented per baud timing until zero when rx_engine.done is asserted.
signals.evidence: rx_engine.bitcnt <= "1010" on start, decremented in receiver when baudcnt expires; rx_engine.done set when bitcnt = "0000"

signals.name: rx_engine.baudcnt
signals.functionality: Counts uart_clk ticks down from a reload value derived from ctrl.baud to sample bits at the correct timing; it is reloaded from ctrl.baud and decremented each uart_clk event.
signals.evidence: rx_engine.baudcnt <= '0' & ctrl.baud(9 downto 1) on start and decremented when uart_clk = '1' in receiver

signals.name: rx_engine.done
signals.functionality: Pulsed when a received character completes; the receiver process asserts this and rx_fifo.we is driven from it to write the assembled byte into the RX FIFO.
signals.evidence: rx_engine.done <= '1' when rx_engine.bitcnt = "0000"; rx_fifo.we <= rx_engine.done

signals.name: rx_engine.sync
signals.functionality: Three-stage synchroniser that samples uart_rxd_i into rx_engine.sync(2) each clock and shifts that sample down on uart_clk to produce stable sampled bits for the receive shift register and start detection.
signals.evidence: rx_engine.sync(2) <= uart_rxd_i; if (uart_clk='1') then rx_engine.sync(1 downto 0) <= rx_engine.sync(2 downto 1) in receiver

signals.name: rx_engine.over
signals.functionality: Indicates an RX FIFO overrun event when a write occurred while FIFO was full; fifo_overrun process sets or clears it depending on ctrl.enable and rx_fifo conditions and bus clears.
signals.evidence: fifo_overrun process sets rx_engine.over <= '1' when (rx_fifo.we='1') and (rx_fifo.free='0'); bus_access reports ctrl_rx_over_c <= rx_engine.over

signals.name: rx_fifo
signals.functionality: Represents the RX FIFO control/status interface: clear, we, re, wdata, rdata, free, avail, half. Fields are driven locally (clear/we/re/wdata) and read by bus_access and IRQ logic, while rdata/avail/free/half are produced by the instantiated fifo component via port map.
role: conveys FIFO status to other logic
signals.evidence: rx FIFO instance port_map connects level/avail/free/half/rdata; rx_fifo.* signals assigned and read throughout source

signals.name: rx_fifo.clear
signals.functionality: Combinationally asserted when ctrl.enable is '0', ctrl.sim_mode is '1', or ctrl.clr_rx is '1' to request FIFO clear. It is driven concurrently from ctrl signals and consumed by the instantiated FIFO component (clear_i).
signals.evidence: rx_fifo.clear <= '1' when (ctrl.enable = '0') or (ctrl.sim_mode = '1') or (ctrl.clr_rx = '1') else '0'; connected to instance clear_i

signals.name: rx_fifo.we
signals.functionality: Drives the FIFO write-enable when the RX engine asserts rx_engine.done; the concurrent assignment ties rx_fifo.we directly to rx_engine.done so completed received bytes are written into the FIFO.
signals.evidence: rx_fifo.we <= rx_engine.done; connected to FIFO instance we_i

signals.name: rx_fifo.re
signals.functionality: Requests a read from the RX FIFO when the bus performs a read at the data address. It is asserted combinationally from bus_req_i.stb/rw/addr conditions and fed to the FIFO instance.
signals.evidence: rx_fifo.re <= '1' when (bus_req_i.stb='1') and (bus_req_i.rw='0') and (bus_req_i.addr(2)='1') else '0'; connected to FIFO instance re_i

signals.name: rx_fifo.wdata
signals.functionality: Carries the assembled received byte into the FIFO. It is assigned from rx_engine.sreg(7 downto 0) and presented to the FIFO instance as wdata_i.
signals.evidence: rx_fifo.wdata <= rx_engine.sreg(7 downto 0); connected to FIFO instance wdata_i

signals.name: rx_fifo.rdata
signals.functionality: Provides data read from the RX FIFO to the bus. It is an output of the FIFO instance (rdata_o) and its value is sampled into bus_rsp_o.data slices when the bus reads the data register.
signals.evidence: rx_fifo.rdata connected to FIFO instance rdata_o; bus_access assigns bus_rsp_o.data(data_rtx_msb_c downto data_rtx_lsb_c) <= rx_fifo.rdata

signals.name: rx_fifo.free
signals.functionality: Status bit from FIFO instance indicating whether FIFO has free space; used in bus responses to indicate RX not-full and in fifo_overrun logic to detect writes into a full FIFO.
role: feeds overrun detection and bus status
signals.evidence: bus_access uses not rx_fifo.free for ctrl_rx_full_c; fifo_overrun checks rx_fifo.free with rx_fifo.we

signals.name: rx_fifo.avail
signals.functionality: Status output from FIFO instance indicating non-empty; used by bus response and rx IRQ generation to report available data and for IRQ triggering when enabled.
signals.evidence: bus_access maps ctrl_rx_nempty_c <= rx_fifo.avail; rx_irq_generator uses rx_fifo.avail

signals.name: rx_fifo.half
signals.functionality: Status output from FIFO indicating half-full threshold; used by the bus response and by rtr_control to decide RTS and by IRQ logic to trigger when enabled.
signals.evidence: bus_access maps ctrl_rx_half_c <= rx_fifo.half; rtr_control checks rx_fifo.half; rx_irq_generator uses rx_fifo.half

signals.name: tx_fifo
signals.functionality: Represents the TX FIFO control/status interface: clear, we, re, wdata, rdata, free, avail, half. Local logic drives clear/we/re/wdata and reads free/avail/half/rdata from the FIFO instance; tx_engine consumes rdata and the IRQ logic consumes status bits.
signals.evidence: tx FIFO instance port_map binds tx_fifo.*; tx_engine loads tx_fifo.rdata; tx_irq_generator and bus_access use tx_fifo status

signals.name: tx_fifo.clear
signals.functionality: Combinational clear request for the TX FIFO asserted when ctrl.enable is '0', ctrl.sim_mode is '1', or ctrl.clr_tx is '1'. Driven from ctrl signals and presented to the FIFO instance clear input.
signals.evidence: tx_fifo.clear <= '1' when (ctrl.enable = '0') or (ctrl.sim_mode = '1') or (ctrl.clr_tx = '1') else '0'; connected to FIFO instance clear_i

signals.name: tx_fifo.we
signals.functionality: Strobes writes into the TX FIFO when a bus write to the TX data register occurs. It is asserted combinationally from bus_req_i.stb/rw/addr conditions and fed to the FIFO instance.
signals.evidence: tx_fifo.we <= '1' when (bus_req_i.stb='1') and (bus_req_i.rw='1') and (bus_req_i.addr(2)='1') else '0'; connected to FIFO instance we_i

signals.name: tx_fifo.re
signals.functionality: Asserted when the transmit engine is in the startup state to fetch the next byte. It is driven combinationally from tx_engine.state and fed to the FIFO instance to produce rdata.
signals.evidence: tx_fifo.re <= '1' when (tx_engine.state = "100") else '0'; connected to FIFO instance re_i

signals.name: tx_fifo.wdata
signals.functionality: Carries the lower byte of the bus write data into the TX FIFO. It is directly assigned from bus_req_i.data(7 downto 0) and supplied to the FIFO instance.
signals.evidence: tx_fifo.wdata <= bus_req_i.data(data_rtx_msb_c downto data_rtx_lsb_c)

signals.name: tx_fifo.rdata
signals.functionality: Data read from the TX FIFO provided to the transmitter. It is produced by the FIFO instance and sampled into the tx_engine.sreg when a transmission starts.
signals.evidence: tx_engine.sreg <= tx_fifo.rdata & '0' in transmitter when starting transmission; rdata_o is mapped to tx_fifo.rdata

signals.name: tx_fifo.free
signals.functionality: Status from FIFO instance indicating free space; used in bus responses to report TX fullness and in bus_access to compute ctrl_tx_full/status bits.
role: feeds bus status and ctrl reporting
signals.evidence: bus_access uses not tx_fifo.free for ctrl_tx_full_c and reports it in bus_rsp_o.data

signals.name: tx_fifo.avail
signals.functionality: Indicates whether TX FIFO contains data (avail). It is read by the transmitter to start transmissions and by bus_access and IRQ logic to report status and trigger interrupts.
signals.evidence: transmitter checks if (tx_fifo.avail = '1') to advance state; bus_access and tx_irq_generator read tx_fifo.avail

signals.name: tx_fifo.half
signals.functionality: Status from the TX FIFO showing near-half threshold; used by IRQ generation and by bus response logic to report nearly-half/full states.
signals.evidence: bus_access reads not tx_fifo.half/tx_fifo.half for status; tx_irq_generator uses tx_fifo.half
